summary: Genmab filed a Form 6-K announcing a de minimis capital increase of 185 shares at DKK 1,334.50 per share (proceeds ~DKK 0.2M) from employee warrant exercises, representing less than 0.001% of share capital. This is a routine administrative update with no special-situation implications. The new shares are ordinary, freely transferable, and will list on Nasdaq Copenhagen. No board recommendation, valuation premium, or strategic action is involved. The filing does not constitute a tender offer, buyback, restructuring, or other special event. The increase is expected to close shortly; nothing material to watch or risk-arb angle.
